caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow dish or plate with a scalloped, reddish-brown rim. The plate is decorated with a central motif that includes a stylized yellow building with a green roof, front doors, and multiple windows, flanked by two tall, slim trees. Surrounding the building are floral and leaf designs in red, green, and brown, with three larger, symmetrical flowers with green centers and five reddish-brown petals each. There are also curling tendrils and pairs of smaller red and yellow blossoms, as well as one seashell-like shape on the right and left sides of the plate. An arching line frames the building, and below it, within a shield-like outline in the lower part of the plate, the text "JACOB FUNCK 1804" is inscribed. Along the outer edge of the dish, an inscription runs around the rim in a decorative, handwritten script. The background color of the plate is a warm tan or light ochre with subtle green and yellow shading, and the overall style features folk art motifs with soft, blended colors. The plate is set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Pa. German Plate
